h1: The 7 Best Printer Tables for Home Offices of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: seven printer tables and file-cabinet stands for home offices, compared on tabletop size, storage, casters and cable management.
summary: The HUANUO stand with cable management is the best overall printer table for small offices. The YAOHUOO 22x15 is for large business all-in-one printers, and the VASAGLE CUSTOS is the compact two-drawer option. For people who want filing and a printer surface in one, the GYIIYUO and Letaya cabinets lead.
intro: Most printer tables fail on a measurement buyers forget to take: the printer's footprint plus the space the paper tray and scanner lid need to open. A table that fits the printer body but not the open lid ends up blocking the door of the machine or hanging off the edge.

We reviewed seven printer tables and file-cabinet stands from their listings. We ranked them on tabletop size, storage, mobility, cable routing and how clearly each is labeled for printer use. Several of the picks are file cabinets with a flat top, so we noted where the top surface is the limiting factor.

products.name: HUANUO Printer Stand with Cable Management and Storage Drawer
products.verdict: A purpose-built printer table with real cable routing and a drawer.
products.description:
A printer stand with a dedicated rear cable management channel, locking caster wheels and a storage drawer under the top shelf. It stands at a maximum of 14.1 inches in height and suits compact and mid-size printers. That puts it at $25-50.

Its first finish reflects that it deals with the two problems that plague printer setups: tangled cords and a table that rolls away. The YAOHUOO below has a larger top, but the HUANUO is the better organized of the two.

Buy it for a desk-side or under-desk setup with a standard home printer. The compact top will not suit a large business machine.
products.idealFor: Home offices with a compact or mid-size printer.
products.skipIf: You own a large business all-in-one.

products.name: YAOHUOO 22x15 Large Printer Stand with Drawer
products.verdict: A 22 by 15 inch top for business-class all-in-one printers.
products.description:
A two-tier rolling cart with a 22 inch wide by 15 inch deep tabletop, a built-in storage drawer and casters. It is described as suited to business-class all-in-one printers and sits in the $25-50 bucket.

It ranks second because the listing says less about cable management than the HUANUO. Its bigger top is the reason to pick it, since it gives a large printer room for open lids and paper trays.

Choose it if your printer is a full-size machine. Measure the printer with the trays extended before ordering.

products.name: VASAGLE CUSTOS 2-Drawer File Cabinet Printer Stand
products.verdict: A small file cabinet labeled and sized for printers.
products.description:
A two-drawer file cabinet measuring 15.7 inches wide, 16.5 inches deep and 27.6 inches tall, in matte black. It is marketed as a printer stand, has a rolling base, and its drawers take A4 and Letter documents. Budget about $50-100.

We placed it third since its 15.7 inch width is narrower than the YAOHUOO, so large machines will overhang. In exchange, it adds a proper filing drawer pair.

Good for small home offices that need a compact printer table plus file space. Check your printer width against 15.7 inches.
products.idealFor: Small offices needing filing and a printer top.
products.skipIf: Your printer is wider than 15 inches.

products.name: GYIIYUO 2 Drawer File Cabinet with 24-inch Extended Desktop
products.verdict: A 24 inch extended desktop with two fabric-front drawers.
products.description:
A mobile file cabinet with a 24 inch extended desktop surface, two fabric-front drawers that fit A4 and Letter files, a side storage bag and a rolling base. The tag falls at $50-100.

Landing fourth here is down to the point that fabric-front drawers are less rigid than the metal and wood cabinets, though the 24 inch top is larger than the VASAGLE's. It trades sturdiness for a more flexible work surface.

Pick it if you want a mobile printer-and-paper station with extra desk space. Look closely at the drawer construction.
products.idealFor: Mobile work stations that need extra surface.

products.name: HOOBRO 2-Tier Printer Stand with Charging Station
products.verdict: An open two-tier stand with a built-in charging station shelf.
products.description:
A 2-tier open shelf printer stand with a charging station shelf, a rustic brown and black finish, and a height low enough to fit under many desks. Cost bracket: $25-50.

Our fifth ranking exists because it has no drawer and no wheels listed, unlike the HUANUO. Its charging shelf is the distinctive feature, useful for keeping devices near the printer.

Choose it if you want open shelf storage and a charging spot. For files, use a drawer model.
products.idealFor: Desks needing device charging near the printer.

products.name: DEVAISE 3-Drawer Mobile File Cabinet
products.verdict: Three lateral file drawers with a wide, stable top.
products.description:
A three-drawer lateral file cabinet in a rustic brown finish with rolling casters and a wide, stable flat top. You will spend $50-100.

It takes the sixth spot as it is storage first and printer table second, with no printer-specific features like cable management. The wide top is the saving grace for larger machines.

Buy it if you have a lot of paperwork and want a printer to sit on top. Pick the HUANUO if cable routing matters more.
products.idealFor: Offices with heavy paperwork and a big printer.
products.skipIf: You only need a small printer stand.

products.name: Letaya 3 Drawer Mobile File Cabinet with Lock
products.verdict: Three lockable metal drawers, assembled on arrival.
products.description:
A metal mobile file cabinet with three lockable drawers that fit Letter, Legal and A4 documents. It ships fully assembled and fits under a desk. It sits in the $50-100 bucket.

It ranks last as a printer table because the top is not marketed for printers and the listing is silent on top size. Its edge is the lock, which the other cabinets here do not name.

Choose it if you store private paperwork near your printer. Confirm the top is large enough for your machine.
products.skipIf: You need a confirmed printer-sized top.

whatMatters.detail: The top must hold the printer body and leave room for trays and lids to open. A table that is exactly printer-sized will feel cramped. Measure your printer with all trays out and compare with the listed width and depth.

whatMatters.factor: Height and fit under a desk
whatMatters.detail: A table that slides under your desk saves floor space but may place the printer too low to reach comfortably. A taller cabinet puts controls at hand. Check the listed height against your desk clearance.
A printer needs both a power cord and a USB or network cable. A rear channel keeps those from snagging. Look for a named cable routing feature in the listing.
Wheels let you roll the printer out for paper jams, but unlocked wheels can drift. Locking casters keep the table put. Check whether the listing says locking.
A heavy laser all-in-one can exceed what a thin shelf supports. The listing may give a limit in pounds. Compare it to the printer's weight on its spec page.

faq.q: How do I know if a printer table will fit my printer?
faq.a: Measure the printer's width and depth with trays and lids open. Compare to the table's listed top size and keep a few inches spare.

faq.q: What is the most common mistake?
faq.a: Buying a table that only fits the printer closed. Open trays and scanner lids need space too.

faq.q: Is a file cabinet worth it over an open stand?
faq.a: If you store paperwork, yes. The VASAGLE gives printer height and drawers together. If not, an open stand costs less.

faq.q: How do I set up a printer table?
faq.a: Assemble the frame, lock the casters, place the printer and route cables through the channel if offered. Leave room around vents.
Hard plastic wheels can mark soft flooring. Use a mat or choose wheels with soft treads.

faq.q: Why are some picks file cabinets?
faq.a: Many home offices need paper storage near the printer. We included cabinets with a flat top and noted where the top size is the limit.

finalTake: The HUANUO is the best printer table for most home offices, with cable routing and locking casters at a low price. Choose the YAOHUOO for large machines, the VASAGLE for a compact file-and-print stand, and the Letaya if lockable storage matters. Always measure the printer with its trays open.
